observations: Photo 0: Laptop shown at an angle, partially open, inside a box. The lid has a small sticker with 'ASUS' and 'ROG' visible. The right side shows ports including USB-C and HDMI. The keyboard has RGB backlighting.

Photo 1: Laptop open, displaying Windows 11 default wallpaper. The keyboard has a sticker indicating 'Intel Core' and 'NVIDIA RTX'. The laptop is placed inside a branded box with 'ROG' and 'Republic of Gamers' visible.

Photo 2: Laptop shown from the back and side. The back panel has a large vented area. The left side shows ports including USB-A, USB-C, and possibly an Ethernet port. The box lid has 'INSPIRE' and 'Q AH' visible, likely part of 'ASUS' branding.
All photos show the same laptop, placed inside a branded box. The box appears to be the original packaging for an ASUS ROG product.

claims.claim: 2022 ASUS ROG Zephyrus M16 gaming laptop
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'ASUS' and 'ROG' on the lid sticker; photo 1 shows 'ROG' on the box and 'Intel Core' and 'NVIDIA RTX' stickers; photo 2 shows 'ROG' on the box. The design matches the Zephyrus M16 series.
The screen is on and shows Windows 11 wallpaper, but resolution and refresh rate cannot be confirmed from photos alone. No on-screen display settings or calibration tools are visible.
Photo 1 shows a sticker with 'Intel Core' on the keyboard, indicating Intel processor.

risks.risk: The laptop may be a refurbished or used unit with hidden wear or damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A full 360-degree video showing all edges, hinges, screen bezels, and underside, including close-ups of ports and keyboard keys.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used, with potential for lower value due to unseen wear.

risks.risk: The display may have dead pixels, screen burn-in, or color issues not visible in the current wallpaper.
risks.proof: A video showing the screen with solid color tests (black, white, red, green, blue) and a full-screen test pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially defective display, reducing value.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be the 2022 model as claimed, or may have been upgraded or downgraded internally.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information (Windows + R, then 'msinfo32') showing exact model, processor, GPU, and BIOS version.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverified model, potentially lower than 2022 spec.

risks.risk: The laptop may have been previously damaged or repaired, with internal issues not visible externally.
risks.proof: A video of the laptop being powered on, showing boot-up, BIOS screen, and running a stress test (e.g., FurMark or Prime95) for 5 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or unstable, reducing value.

proof_requests: A video showing the laptop from all angles, including close-ups of ports, hinges, and keyboard.
A video of the screen with solid color tests and a full-screen test pattern.
A screenshot of the system information (msinfo32) showing exact model, processor, GPU, and BIOS version.
A video of the laptop booting up, showing BIOS, and running a stress test for 5 minutes.
response.reason: The laptop appears to be an ASUS ROG Zephyrus M16, but critical claims about display specs, model year, and internal condition cannot be verified from the photos alone. Hidden risks such as screen defects, internal damage, or non-original components affect pricing. Proof is needed to confirm the model, display quality, and functionality before pricing.
